existing_definition: Existing refers to root-axis identity and includes newly elongated portions of an existing root; it does not assert that every current pixel was visible previously.
main_mean: Arithmetic mean of per-position length shares for actually adjacent observed dates, matching the previous descriptive field-average convention.
supplemental_means: previous-observed intervals including gaps, separately labelled
uncertainty: Retain the original uncertainty flag. Provisional raw shares and assigned-support shares have separate denominators; do not mix them.
statistics: Sample SD is computed after per-position category grouping; SDs are not added. Positions/dates are not independent biological replicates.
